scripts.bootstrap: bun ci && docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis mailpit caddy && DB_CONNECTION=pgsql DB_DATABASE=starter DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PASSWORD=starter DB_PORT=${POSTGRES_PORT:-15432} DB_USERNAME=starter composer --working-dir apps/api run setup && bun run hooks:install
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis mailpit caddy && API_HOST=${API_HOST:-0.0.0.0} API_PORT=${API_PORT:-18000} APP_URL=${APP_URL:-http://localhost:${WEB_PUBLIC_PORT:-13000}} BROADCAST_CONNECTION=reverb CACHE_STORE=redis DB_CONNECTION=pgsql DB_DATABASE=starter DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PASSWORD=starter DB_PORT=${POSTGRES_PORT:-15432} DB_USERNAME=starter MAIL_HOST=127.0.0.1 MAIL_MAILER=smtp MAIL_PORT=${MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT:-11025} NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_APP_KEY=${REVERB_APP_KEY:-starter-key} QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=${REDIS_PORT:-16379} REVERB_APP_ID=${REVERB_APP_ID:-starter} REVERB_APP_KEY=${REVERB_APP_KEY:-starter-key} REVERB_APP_SECRET=${REVERB_APP_SECRET:-starter-secret} REVERB_HOST=127.0.0.1 REVERB_PORT=${REVERB_PORT:-19080} REVERB_SCHEME=http REVERB_SERVER_PORT=${REVERB_PORT:-19080} SESSION_DRIVER=redis WEB_HOST=${WEB_HOST:-0.0.0.0} WEB_PORT=${WEB_PORT:-13100} bun run --parallel --filter web --filter api dev
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis mailpit caddy
scripts.hooks:install: if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then bunx lefthook install; else echo 'Skipping Lefthook outside a Git worktree.'; fi
scripts.config:check: composer --working-dir apps/api validate --strict && docker compose config --quiet && bun run coolify:check
scripts.audit: bun dedupe --check && bun audit --audit-level=high && composer audit --working-dir apps/api --locked
scripts.check: bun run config:check && bun run --parallel --if-present --filter '*' format:check lint typecheck test build
scripts.contracts:build: bun run --filter @vinext-laravel-starter/http-contract build && bun run --filter @vinext-laravel-starter/api-client generate && bun run --filter @vinext-laravel-starter/realtime-contract generate
